title: Multimodal VLM & Long-Video Inference Serving Architecture Selection (Monolithic ViT+LLM vs. EPD 3-Stage Disaggregation vs. Vision Embedding Cache vs. Spatio-Temporal Token Compression)

calibration_sources: anonymized_reported: SGLang / vLLM V1 Multimodal EPD Disaggregation & Vision Embedding Cache Architecture (2025-2026)
anonymized_reported: DistServe-VLM / ModServe Encode-Prefill-Decode 3-Stage Resource Disaggregation Benchmarks
anonymized_reported: FastV / ToMe / LLaVA-OneVision / Qwen2.5-VL Spatio-Temporal Vision Token Compression Specs
provenance.notes: All 16xH100 ($40.00/hr) 72B VLM throughput, TTFT, P99 TPOT, KV footprint, and per-1k-request cost figures are deterministic analytical outputs from run.py. Physical 16-GPU H100 cluster execution is not_measured.

baseline_workload.model_architecture: 72B VLM (ViT-4B Dense Vision Encoder + MLP Projector + 70B GQA-8 LLM Backbone)

tier1_monolithic_colocated_vlm.label: Tier 1: Monolithic Co-Located VLM (CPU FFmpeg + Inline ViT + Colocated TP8 LLM)
tier1_monolithic_colocated_vlm.media_decode_path: CPU FFmpeg software video/image decode + PCIe host-to-device copy
tier1_monolithic_colocated_vlm.vit_execution_topology: Inline ViT-4B on LLM TP=8 group (wasting 8 GPUs on 4B encoder, blocking decode)
tier1_monolithic_colocated_vlm.vision_embedding_cache: None (re-decodes & re-encodes raw media on every turn)
tier1_monolithic_colocated_vlm.verdict: Not recommended for video/high-res VLM: inline ViT + 16K prefill stalls streaming decode for >1.8s (P99 TPOT 385ms).

tier2_gpu_nvdec_epd_disaggregation.label: Tier 2: GPU NVDEC + EPD 3-Stage Disaggregation (2E + 8P + 6D GPU Pools)
tier2_gpu_nvdec_epd_disaggregation.media_decode_path: Hardware GPU NVDEC + NVIDIA DALI zero-copy tensor pipeline
tier2_gpu_nvdec_epd_disaggregation.vit_execution_topology: Dedicated DP ViT Encode Pool (2 GPUs) -> RDMA FP16/FP8 embedding push to 8P + 6D
tier2_gpu_nvdec_epd_disaggregation.vision_embedding_cache: None (disaggregated E->P->D pipeline, fresh encode per turn)
tier2_gpu_nvdec_epd_disaggregation.verdict: Baseline production disaggregation: isolates Decode from ViT/Prefill bursts (P99 TPOT 385ms -> 34.0ms, 11.3x reduction).

tier3_epd_plus_vision_embedding_cache.label: Tier 3: EPD Disaggregation + Distributed SHA-256 Vision Embedding Cache (75% Multi-Turn Hit)
tier3_epd_plus_vision_embedding_cache.media_decode_path: GPU NVDEC on miss (25%) + Zero-Encode SHA-256 Embedding Cache hit (75%)
tier3_epd_plus_vision_embedding_cache.vit_execution_topology: Dedicated ViT Pool bypassed on cache hits; post-projector embeddings streamed via RDMA
tier3_epd_plus_vision_embedding_cache.vision_embedding_cache: Content-addressed SHA-256(media_bytes + vit_ver + res_profile) in Host DRAM / NVMe
tier3_epd_plus_vision_embedding_cache.verdict: Best lossless multi-turn VLM/OCR architecture: eliminates 75% redundant ViT encodes & hits multimodal prefix cache (680ms TTFT).

tier4_epd_cache_plus_adaptive_token_comp.label: Tier 4: EPD + Embedding Cache + 4.0x Spatio-Temporal Token Compression (ToMe / FastV 16K -> 4K)
tier4_epd_cache_plus_adaptive_token_comp.media_decode_path: GPU NVDEC + SHA-256 Embedding Cache + Spatio-Temporal Token Merging/Pruning
tier4_epd_cache_plus_adaptive_token_comp.vit_execution_topology: EPD Disaggregated + 4.0x Temporal-Spatial Pruning before LLM Backbone (1.5x OCR bypass)
tier4_epd_cache_plus_adaptive_token_comp.vision_embedding_cache: Compressed post-projector embeddings (67.1 MB vs 268.4 MB raw) + Multimodal RadixCache
tier4_epd_cache_plus_adaptive_token_comp.verdict: Optimal for long-video QA & real-time embodied/desktop agents: 3.68x KV reduction, 8.98x lower TTFT (245ms), 7.69x throughput ($0.45/1k req).
